title: NHS evidence-led writing Studios, workflow guidance and collapsible navigation
steps: Trace current prompts, inputs, validation and navigation
Research official NHS/NHSBSA and GOV.UK guidance
Add persistent accessible sidebar and accurate live run previews
Add reviewed person-specification/evidence planning, employer instructions and field limits to both Statement Studio and Cover Studio

Verify, deploy and capture protected production state

No paid model inference or application submission during verification
